label: Leaderboard watch
info: Alerts Discord when a player takes #1 on the Aim Assist leaderboard. See PLAN-AUTOMATION.md in the repo.

name: Check the board, decide, post, then save
info:
Logic: automation/watcher/ in the Aim Assist repo (global.get("watcher")).
State: flow context, "file" store, key top_<view>.

name: Leaderboard request
func:
// GET /api/leaderboard for msg.view, from the app at AIM_ASSIST_URL.
msg.url = `${env.get('AIM_ASSIST_URL')}/api/leaderboard?view=${encodeURIComponent(msg.view)}`
msg.requestTimeout = 10000
delete msg.payload
return msg

name: Decide
Flags + Claude request
Merge verdict
Save, or retry once on 429
Fixtures: press Reset, then 1 to 5 in order (6 after 1)
info: Fake boards fed straight into Decide under view "fixture", with their own saved state (top_fixture). Fixtures 2, 3 and 6 go through Claude and post to Discord like real alerts. Press "fetch fails" 3 times for the watchdog notice, then any fixture for the recovery notice.

name: Forget fixture state
